0.0: Hold it! That hairdo is a violation of Public Decency Code 17S.30B, the Obnoxious Locks Movement. I'm afraid I'm going to require you to help me as community service... and luckily I need help dealing with all these non-stop non-stoppers!
0.1: I may be the best cop in Singapore, but I'm still only one man. I need the right equipment! And you're going to help me out, aren't you?

yes.0: Of course you will, I'd give you a citation otherwise! I need you to defeat #b100 #o9420508#s#k and collect #b100 #t4000373#s#k. We're going to make this place safe for pedestrians if it's the last thing I do...

no.0: Saying no to a police officer is violation of the Nuh Uh Act... I wish that had a different name.

1.0: Any idea where I can find more stop sign parts?

yes.0: I'm pretty sure you had to have broken some laws to get the materials that fast. Were you moving at a rate above 37.4 clicks per fortnight? I guess I can overlook it this time...

item.0: Defeat #b100 #o9420500#s#k and gather #b100 #t4000373#s#k. Every second you delay, you put the lives of innocent pedestrians at risk! Are you not familiar with the penalties for violating the Pedestrian Well-Being Act?
